formula: T=A+150*tanh(correction_trend/150); e=150*(tanh((correction_trend+correction_event)/150)-tanh(correction_trend/150)); upper_only=T+(0,0,0,e,e), with original alpha unchanged. Saved implementation copies first three quantiles from same-head event_off and last two from Full.
sampling: all archived formal evaluation origins and all 24 horizons; no subsampling
decision: upper_only macro QS strictly improves on both original and event_off; each region mean MAE/QS does not worsen relative to original for all and each protected price group; regional all QS does not worsen relative to event_off; each regional all absolute 80/90 coverage deviation worsens by at most .01 relative to original; complete nine-case identity and arithmetic checks pass; all protected groups nonempty. Otherwise stop_upper_only_event_allocation.
episode_horizons: all 24, each separately on unique target hours; never pool episode counts across horizons or neural seeds
statistical_scope: descriptive paired screening only; numeric tolerance is not a statistical noninferiority margin; no confidence or significance claims
limitations: This is original candidate three, not the second candidate mature-residual baseline and not another upper-scale removal.
event_off retains event proposal input to the learned history gates; it removes only the direct event term with all other computations fixed.
Formal raw and development outputs have no matching event_off; do not borrow another checkpoint or fabricate them.
2023/2024 have already been inspected. Three neural seeds and overlapping forecasts are not independent market repeats.
Upper quantiles crossing a price threshold are forecast diagnostics, not fitted event probabilities.
A pass allows a separate prospective L1 design only. Failure stops this allocation candidate, not an automatic change to the formal model.
